tools.name: regulatory-intelligence_uk-details
tools.description: Retrieve UK legislation details, publication dates, commencement information, and amendment metadata from legislation.gov.uk XML data. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/regulatory-intelligence/uk/details. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: regulatory-intelligence_us-search
tools.description: Search US Federal Register documents by keyword, agency, document type, and publication date using the official federalregister.gov API. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/regulatory-intelligence/us/search. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: regulatory-intelligence_us-details
tools.description: Retrieve US Federal Register document details and effective dates from the official federalregister.gov API. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/regulatory-intelligence/us/details. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: regulatory-intelligence_us-agencies
tools.description: Retrieve list of US Federal Register agencies with their IDs and metadata from the official federalregister.gov API. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/regulatory-intelligence/us/agencies. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "regulatory-intelligence" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: regulatory-intelligence_uk-search, regulatory-intelligence_uk-details, regulatory-intelligence_us-search, regulatory-intelligence_us-details, regulatory-intelligence_us-agencies · Private data: regulatory-intelligence_uk-search, regulatory-intelligence_us-search, regulatory-intelligence_us-details · Public sink: regulatory-intelligence_uk-search, regulatory-intelligence_uk-details, regulatory-intelligence_us-search, regulatory-intelligence_us-details, regulatory-intelligence_us-agencies · Destructive: regulatory-intelligence_uk-search, regulatory-intelligence_uk-details, regulatory-intelligence_us-search, regulatory-intelligence_us-details, regulatory-intelligence_us-agencies.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
